detection_precision.definition: Correctly detected positive cases divided by all predicted-positive cases.

detection_recall.definition: Correctly detected positive cases divided by all ground-truth positive cases.

detection_f1.definition: Harmonic mean of case-level detection precision and recall.

false_positive_rate.definition: False-positive cases divided by all ground-truth negative cases.

detection_accuracy.definition: Correctly classified cases (true positives plus true negatives) divided by all labeled cases.

detection_rule_exact_case_accuracy.definition: Cases whose complete deterministic rule-ID set exactly matches the ground-truth set.

attack_mapping_exact_case_accuracy.definition: Cases whose complete ATT&CK technique-ID set exactly matches the reference set.

severity_risk_category_accuracy.definition: Cases whose deterministic risk category matches the reference label.

related_event_group_exact_accuracy.definition: Reference event groups exactly matched by correlation output.

expected_evidence_coverage.definition: Expected event IDs included among detection evidence references.

detection_evidence_id_validity.definition: Detection evidence references that point to an event in the synthetic dataset.

verification_supported_claim_rate.definition: Supported evaluation probes returned as supported.

unsupported_claim_detection_rate.definition: Unsupported/contradicted probes flagged as unsupported or contradicted.

verification_probe_exact_status_accuracy.definition: Evaluation probes whose verifier status exactly matches the reference status.

response_recommendation_safety_complianc.definition: Recommendations satisfying non-execution, event-reference, approval, and verifier-consistency constraints.
